name: Fiber
description: Fiber Format is a DM era format that predates the first banlist. The latest core set is Legacy of Darkness (LOD). Notable additions include Exiled Force, Fiber Jar, Injection Fairy Lily, Yata-Garasu and Reinforcement of the Army. These cards create interesting new dynamics between card advantage and life points, particularly with Fiber Jar's ability to reset the game.

defining_cards.name: Fiber Jar
defining_cards.why: Flipping it reset both fields, hands and Graveyards into the Decks, then gave each player five new cards while preserving the LP difference.

defining_cards.name: Injection Fairy Lily
defining_cards.why: Paying 2000 LP during damage calculation turned a 400 ATK monster into a 3400 ATK answer to larger threats.

defining_cards.name: Exiled Force
defining_cards.why: This searchable Warrior could tribute itself to destroy a monster, including a face-down threat before its Flip Effect mattered.

defining_cards.name: Yata-Garasu
defining_cards.why: A successful hit skipped the opponent's next draw, letting an empty-hand opponent be locked out by repeated attacks.

defining_cards.name: Mystic Tomato
defining_cards.why: Losing it in battle could bring Sangan or another small DARK monster straight from the Deck, keeping a monster in play.
